scopeLimits: Research covered public first-party discovery, the BIC viewer's current public page/bundle, and anonymous bounded REST requests only.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe owner/title/address/tax query was used.
No parcel polygon was retained because no safe native identity plus public geometry response was available.
The official custodian listing is not equivalent to citywide digital parcel coverage.
safeFieldAllowlist: source field names in metadata only
runtimeReadinessReason: Independent serial adapter qualification remains outstanding; this packet records source discovery only and does not claim source integration/admission.
uncertainty: BIC's advertised province coverage may change independently of the Ministry's local registry records.
